newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - April 24.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - April 24.

text.p: Following are views on the direction of Philippine stocks on Thursday and main factors likely to affect trading.

* Market seen bearish on lack of positive news to keep buying momentum going and any uptick may be capped by the Dow's loss and unconvincing rebound of property stocks on Wednesday, said Dharmala Securities analyst Elline Salvatierra.
* Angping & Associates Securities analyst Alexis Cabel said index-linked Petron Corp's miniscule earnings for the first quarter of the year may fuel cautiousness in the market.
* Dharmala said it has pegged support at 2,850 points.
